action: General advice: if Boston Scientific notifies you, follow the instructions in the letter. BleepingComputer reports the notice recommends free credit reports and considering fraud alerts and credit freezes.
date_note: The California AG listing gives dates of May 7 and May 12, 2026 but no filing date; the earliest read page with a publication day is BleepingComputer's, 27 November.
exec: A medical device maker is notifying people that personal and medical information was accessed through its cloud infrastructure, per BleepingComputer.
plain: Boston Scientific is notifying people that attackers reached its cloud systems and may have exposed personal and medical details, according to a notice reported by BleepingComputer.
summary: Boston Scientific filed a breach notification with California's Attorney General listing breach dates of May 7 and May 12, 2026. BleepingComputer, citing a notification sample, reports the attacker used voice phishing to access the company's cloud infrastructure and that data included Social Security numbers, medical and health insurance information. The letter says patient medical records and remote-monitoring data were not exposed.
title: Boston Scientific notifies people of a data breach through cloud access, including medical information

validation.note: California AG listing (primary) and BleepingComputer read; the AG's attached letter PDF could not be text-read, so the vishing and data details rest on BleepingComputer.
